translation:
<ins>Rhinoceros Horn and Rehmannia Decoction (犀角地黃湯)</ins>
Rhinoceros horn (犀角), raw rehmannia (生地黃, soaked in wine, pounded separately), moutan bark (丹皮), white peony (白芍, each equal parts)
Decoct in water and take. <ins>Peach Kernel Qi-Guiding Decoction (桃仁承氣湯)</ins>
Rhubarb (大黃), mirabilite (芒硝), peach kernel (桃仁), cinnamon twig (桂枝), licorice (甘草)
Decoct in water and take, stopping when there is a bowel movement (以利為度). <ins>Di-Dang Decoction (抵當湯)</ins>
Leech (水蛭), gadfly (虻蟲, wings and feet removed, thirty of each), rhubarb (大黃, soaked in wine, three liang), peach kernel (桃仁, skin and tip removed, thirty)
Decoct in water, remove the dregs, take three sheng, take one sheng warm; if there is no bowel movement, take again.
